scenario: A recruiter dismisses and reopens Ask while an evidence review is live, later encounters a stale review authority, and must recover without duplicate work, false success, obsolete retries, or lost draft text.
frozen_evidence: /tmp/talent-signal-v10-release.xcresult: unsigned generic iOS Release build passed

review_plan.reason: The delta changes interruption and recovery burden in a core recruiter workflow.
The delta represents terminal evidence-authority and protected recovery state.
The delta changes mobile recovery controls, focus, and draft behavior.
Truthful evidence conflict feedback affects candidate time and recruiter trust.
The artifact does not assess, rank, score, or predict a candidate.

findings.observation: Session-owned keys resolve the prior ownership defect logically, but no delayed Ask dismissal/reopen transition proves the rendered progress state, absence of reconciliation, or exact request count.
findings.evidence: Hash-matched store/view source and the 98/98 unit bundle prove same-store duplicate claim rejection and relaunch semantics; runtime-evidence.json lists direct transition proof as missing.
findings.user_impact: A spinner, stale recovery control, focus loss, or second request could still escape store-level tests.
findings.recommendation: Freeze delayed close/reopen and kill/relaunch journeys with rendered state and request counts.
findings.verification: Close/reopen shows one live progress state, no reconcile, and one request; relaunch shows no synthetic success and one protected recovery path.

strengths: The store-level ownership split is quiet, preserves recruiter control, and does not add external-effect authority.
missing_evidence: Delayed close/reopen, kill/relaunch, real stale-authority UI, physical accessibility, production Apple/microphone, and field evidence are missing.
open_questions: Does every shipping Ask presentation retain the same account-session store?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: If saving superseded fails, the protected store rolls back to pending and can re-expose obsolete-key reconciliation after the live owner releases the key.
findings.evidence: Hash-matched updateEvidenceReview rollback, stale-error mapping, and pending-card branching; the executed test covers successful superseded persistence only.
findings.user_impact: The backend stays safe, but the recruiter can enter repeated doomed reconciliation attempts.
findings.recommendation: Retain a same-process terminal guard after observed stale authority and enforce a terminal model transition.
findings.verification: Injected terminal-save failure never shows applied or obsolete-key retry and offers only a fresh Ask in the current process.

strengths: Exact stale-code matching cannot mark the old operation applied; the V9 canonical authority chain remains fail closed.
missing_evidence: Terminal persistence failure, direct transitions, revoked/expired/deleted retry runtime, physical/production/field and deletion evidence are missing.
open_questions: What non-durable representation should suppress obsolete-key retry when durable terminal save fails?

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: Ask with current evidence unconditionally replaces the composer, and every draft change is persisted, so the recommended recovery action silently overwrites an existing unsent question.
findings.evidence: Hash-matched RelationshipAskView restores and saves drafts but assigns What is current now without checking whether draft is empty.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can lose carefully composed work at the exact moment recovery should preserve continuity.
findings.recommendation: Seed only an empty composer; otherwise preserve the draft and focus it.
findings.verification: A persisted nonempty draft remains byte-for-byte unchanged after invoking the current-evidence action.

findings.observation: The store permits markEvidenceReviewPending to move a superseded operation back to pending, so terminality depends on the current presentation branch.
findings.evidence: Hash-matched store setter has no prior-state guard; the superseded test does not attempt the reverse transition.
findings.user_impact: A future caller could resurrect an obsolete key and restore a dead-end retry loop.
findings.recommendation: Reject superseded to pending in AgentSessionStore.
findings.verification: The failed transition preserves state, message, updated time, and idempotency key.

findings.observation: No V10 frozen UI or assistive-technology output covers live-owner, restored-pending, or superseded states.
findings.evidence: V10 runtime missing-evidence list and V9 initial-screen-only AX5 baseline.
findings.user_impact: Long copy, focus, order, or recovery controls may fail for accessibility users.
findings.recommendation: Freeze all three transitions at AX5 and inspect physical VoiceOver/Switch Control.
findings.verification: Identity, evidence, state, warning, and action semantics remain visible and announced in order.

strengths: The intended live-owner split and exact stale-code mapping are coherent, build cleanly, and avoid synthetic success.
missing_evidence: Delayed/relaunch/stale UI, draft preservation UI, complete AX5, physical accessibility, production Apple/microphone, and field proof are missing.
vetoes: Active: the recommended superseded-authority action can silently overwrite and persist over an existing Ask draft.
open_questions: Should the suggestion seed only an empty composer?
Which owner guarantees store lifetime across presentation changes?

reviews.lens: human connection, trust, agency, communication, collaboration

findings.criterion: Dignified failure, truthful communication, and time respect
findings.observation: On terminal-state persistence failure the notice says newer evidence is current while the rolled-back pending card can offer Reconcile safely for the obsolete key.
findings.evidence: Hash-matched rollback, stale-error handling, key release, and card branching; no test covers this transition.
findings.user_impact: Contradictory recovery guidance wastes recruiter attention and may delay a truthful candidate update.
findings.recommendation: Keep a session-terminal block after observed stale authority even when durable save fails, and expose only the fresh current-evidence path.
findings.verification: Injected persistence failure retains stale answer, hides reconcile, preserves the draft, and performs no write until the recruiter explicitly sends.

strengths: The durable path uses truthful terminal copy, keeps the old answer stale, and does not automatically send or execute work.
missing_evidence: Persistence failure, direct UI transitions, candidate-facing commitments, physical accessibility, production, and field evidence are missing.
open_questions: Can a non-durable current-session terminal guard remain truthful without claiming relaunch durability?

top_findings.reason: The recovery action can silently overwrite a persisted nonempty draft.
top_findings.next_step: Preserve nonempty drafts and seed only an empty composer.
top_findings.verification: Unit and UI transition prove draft bytes are unchanged.

top_findings.reason: A failed superseded save can re-expose obsolete-key reconciliation in the same process.
top_findings.next_step: Add a session-terminal guard independent of durable-save success.
top_findings.verification: Injected save failure shows current-evidence path only and sends no obsolete review request.

top_findings.reason: The store permits superseded to pending.
top_findings.next_step: Reject that transition in the model.
top_findings.verification: A deterministic unit test preserves the entire terminal operation.

agreements: The prior V9 defects are materially improved in normal source/unit paths.
No old operation can appear applied and no fresh Ask is sent automatically.
Direct transitions, physical accessibility, production, and field evidence remain missing.

veto_resolution.veto: Active: the recommended superseded-authority action can silently overwrite and persist over an existing Ask draft.
veto_resolution.resolution: Seed suggested text only when the composer is empty and prove nonempty draft preservation.
veto_resolution.evidence: Hash-matched V10 source shows unconditional draft replacement; no contrary runtime evidence exists.

adjudication.rationale: One active mobile veto and a protected-save contradiction block V10. Specialist scores remain attached to their rubrics and are not averaged.

next_tests.test: Nonempty draft preservation under superseded recovery.
next_tests.evidence_required: Store/view unit plus frozen UI transition.
next_tests.pass_condition: Draft and persisted value remain unchanged; only focus moves.

next_tests.test: Superseded persistence failure and terminal transition invariant.
next_tests.evidence_required: Injected save failure, source/unit proof, and rendered control state.
next_tests.pass_condition: No obsolete-key retry in-process; superseded cannot return to pending.

next_tests.test: Delayed/relaunch/stale transitions and physical accessibility/production/field proof.
next_tests.evidence_required: Recordings, request counts, assistive-tech transcript, production authorization, and structured field observation.
next_tests.pass_condition: Critical states are truthful, reachable, nonduplicative, and preserve recruiter work.
